resources.string: Pump integration for Medtrum Nano and Medtrum 300U
Pump is suspended due to hourly max insulin exceeded
Pump is suspended due to daily max insulin exceeded
Setting user settings to pump failed!
Error while syncing history from pump, a record has been skipped. Check treatment tab to check if bolus is synced correctly. Snooze and if error keep coming back change patch or pumpbase.
The patch restarted by itself and lost its session. It cannot deliver insulin any more. Remove the patch and start a new one.
Failed to update pump timezone, snooze message and refresh manually.
This will clear the stored pump serial number and disconnect. Activate a new patch to scan for a pump.
Connect the pump base to a fresh patch to power it on, then select it from the list below.
No active patch. Press Next to begin the activation process.
Make sure the pump base is connected to the patch, remove the residual air and fill with insulin, then press Next.
Note: A minimum of 70 units is required for activation.
Do not attach the patch to the body yet.
Half-press needle button. Then tap Next to start prime.
Please wait for the priming to complete.
Remove the safety lock. Attach the pump to the body. Press the needle button.
Activating pump and setting initial basal rate. Please Wait.
You can export the settings to be able to recover this patch session later.
Press OK to return to main screen.
Are you sure that you want to deactivate the current patch?
Are you sure that you want to cancel the activation?
Are you sure? This action cannot be reversed!!
Press Next to deactivate or Cancel to return to main screen.
Failed to deactivate, press Discard to forget patch.
Retract needle. Remove patch from body.
Remove pump base and dispose of used patch appropriately.
Press OK to return to main screen. Press Next to start activation of new patch.
Oops! Something went wrong, it seems there is already an activation in progress.
Press Next to resume the activation or Discard to reset the activation status.
Please wait, reading activation status from pump.
Select your preferred pump alarm settings.
Show notification on non critical pump warnings: low battery, low reservoir (20 units) and expires soon. Recommended to leave enabled when pump alarms are set to silent.
Show notification on specified hour after activation.
When enabled, the patch will expire after 3 days, with a grace period of 8 hours after that.
Specify the maximum units of insulin allowed per hour. If exceeded, the pump will suspend.
Specify the maximum units of insulin allowed per day. If exceeded, the pump will suspend.

WARNING: Only enable if you have connection problems. If enabled the driver scans for the pump again before trying to reconnect to the pump. Make sure you have Location permission set to "Always allow"

The running patch session is sent to the AAPS app on the watch, and this phone stops talking to the patch until you take a session back in. A file with the session is also written to the AAPS handover folder, so this phone can take it back if the watch never gets it.

The loop on this phone is turned off (Disable loop). Before you go on: no bolus running, and the watch has the same AAPS build.

The watch only reads the patch status. It sends no bolus or basal.
Start engine on watch, keep patch (test)

The settings and history of this phone are sent to the AAPS app on the watch. The engine on the watch starts with them, in open loop, with its own virtual pump.

This phone keeps the patch and its loop. The watch does not talk to the patch.

The engine runs until you stop it on the watch: Medtrum test, Stop engine.
Sent to the watch. The engine on the watch starts in open loop with its virtual pump. Stop it on the watch: Medtrum test, Stop engine.
The snapshot for the watch could not be written. See the log.

This phone takes in the newest patch session file from its AAPS handover folder and then talks to that patch.\n\nOnly do this after the watch has handed the session back, or when the watch never got it. Two devices must never talk to the patch at the same time.

string.name: handover_test_loop_disabled
string.comment: %1$s=the running mode before, for example Closed Loop

resources.string: The loop was turned off (Disable loop). It was: %1$s. You will be asked to turn it back on when this phone takes a session back in.
The loop could not be turned off. Turn it off yourself (Disable loop) before you go on.

string.name: handover_test_restore_mode
string.comment: %1$s=what happened (a whole message), %2$s=the running mode, for example Closed Loop

resources.string: The patch session was moved to another device. This phone does not talk to the patch.
There is no patch session on this phone to move out.
The patch session was already moved out.
The pump is busy. Wait until the command queue is empty and no bolus is running.
No AAPS directory. Choose one in Maintenance first.
The session file could not be written. The patch stays on this phone.
Sent to the watch. Open Medtrum test on the watch to read the patch status. A copy is in %1$s.
The snapshot for the watch (settings and history) could not be written. The session went to the watch alone. See the log.
The watch handed the Medtrum patch session back. Open the Medtrum page and tap Take patch session in.

string.name: handover_test_sent_with_tbr
string.comment: %1$d=number of days, %2$s=temp basal rate, for example 0.00 U/h or 120%, %3$s=time it ends, for example 18:00

resources.string: Sent along: the total daily dose of %1$d days, and the running temp basal (%2$s until %3$s).
Sent along: the total daily dose of %1$d days. No temp basal is running.
The basal the patch had at the other device\'s last read (%1$s) is now in this phone\'s treatments.
The patch history the watch read (%1$d records) is read again at the next status read, so this phone gets everything the watch did.
The total daily doses from %1$s on will be calculated again.
This phone still has its own patch session. Move it to the watch first, or unpair.
No patch session file in the AAPS handover folder (a file starting with Medtrum_session_).
%1$s is not a patch session file.

string.name: handover_test_taken_in
string.comment: %1$s=file name, %2$s=date and time it was moved out

resources.string: Took in %1$s, moved out %2$s. This phone now drives the patch. Use Refresh to read its status.
